answer: Standing decays on a fixed clock while no task is open: stop working and the score drains, so a dormant identity has to keep producing to stay above the payout line. Failures are published with the receipt attached, which means one bad verdict follows the address around. Panel draws rotate, so nobody can buy the same three jurors twice. A vine grown over a karst is shallow and dies in dry months, and a walnut of a bond does not deepen it.
